text:
Nora (Finance): Heads-up: AWS invoice AWR-2028-07-20 contains two charges for the same subscription id — one as a marketplace subscription line and another as a direct subscription. Combined delta = $6,480. Need mapping before close. :thinking:

Diego (Billing): Sample lines?

Nora (Finance):
``` 
Invoice: AWR-2028-07-20
Line1: aws:marketplace:prod-sub:partner-NeoStream:sub-MQ-771 Units: 1 ChargeUSD: 4,200.00  subscription_id: sub-771
Line2: aws:direct:subscription:sub-MQ-771 Units: 1 ChargeUSD: 2,280.00  subscription_id: sub-771
```
Looks like split billing for plan fee + marketplace surcharge but both posted to us as separate billable amounts for the same subscription.

Hannah (Partner Ops): NeoStream told us they switched to a hybrid billing integration last month: marketplace for seat fees, direct for add-ons. They said records should include `linked_subscription` to tie them together. Do the lines have that?

Ravi (Platform): Ingestion shows marketplace lines include `linked_subscription=sub-771` in raw payload, but our transform only reads `linked_sub` (different key). So the link gets lost and we treat them independently. Log: `WARN transform.marketplace - missing key linked_sub; ignoring linked_subscription`

ops-bot: Automated scan: Potential duplicate accounting exposure = $6,480 across 2 lines on AWR-2028-07-20. Suggest reprocess with mapping of linked_subscription -> linked_sub or create temporary clearing entry.

Diego (Billing): If Platform can reprocess mapping linked_subscription to linked_sub we can collapse to single logical subscription allocation. Ravi, ETA?

Ravi (Platform): Small ETL tweak. I can push a patch and reprocess the day's batches in ~90 minutes. Will include a dedupe step that joins on subscription_id + linked_subscription when present.

Hannah (Partner Ops): I'll ask NeoStream to confirm the intended split percentages for revenue share so we can split the allocation correctly once linked.

Nora (Finance): Approve reprocess. If reprocess misses anything, approve a temporary clearing journal up to $7k. Tag: "mp-hybrid-temp".

Ravi (Platform): Patch merged. Starting reprocess job rp-hybrid-771 now. Monitoring: https://billing.internal/jobs/rp-hybrid-771

ops-bot: Reprocess complete (rp-hybrid-771). Outcome: marketplace and direct lines linked; consolidated allocation applied: Net charge allocated to NeoStream = $6,480 with internal split 65% marketplace / 35% direct per partner mapping. Unallocated remaining = $0.00. Reconciliation link: https://billing.internal/recon/AWR-2028-07-20/rp-hybrid-771

Diego (Billing): Verified allocations and ledger entries updated. No journal needed.

Hannah (Partner Ops): NeoStream confirmed the 65/35 split and appreciated quick fix. I'll add note to partner onboarding checklist that `linked_subscription` is supported and must be used if hybrid billing is enabled.

Nora (Finance): Great — please add an entry to the runbook about checking for linked_subscription vs linked_sub and run the reconciliation query we used. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
